high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram feed, specifically showing a sponsored post by the account "birchposh." The post features a pair of glasses with a unique design: one lens is circular, while the other is square. The frames have a tortoiseshell pattern, giving them a stylish and modern look. The top of the image displays the title "Posts you may like," indicating that this is part of a suggested content section on the Instagram app. Below the title, there is a label "Sponsored" next to the username "birchposh," which suggests that this post is an advertisement for the brand.
